pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal regions with sharp, high-contrast edge gradients. Geometry is predominantly characterized by irregular quadrilaterals and pentagons with linear boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored inter-patch pathways. Intersections are primarily trifurcated nodes with a narrow and relatively uniform pixel thickness across the visible torso and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark-colored mane along the superior neck profile, exhibiting low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged serrations against the background pixels.
